reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP, Radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/script/qvm_native_loader.cpp hashes to 48ae1e2700dfc8738d9ea1a31178495ff821c3bed69ac189263a88eebac8359f. Retail 0x004B7E10 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with Radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast, and the recompiled object symbol was read back with objdump at the same source digest. The fallback divergence recorded by the previous review is resolved: the candidate now calls Debug_Error with the formatted buffer as its format argument and ends the path in a self-jump, exactly as retail 0x004B7E67-0x004B7E74.

retail_function.name: Qvm_ReportError
retail_function.summary: 0x004B7E10-0x004B7E76 (102 bytes, 6 blocks/7 edges): load 0x00A96598; store 1 to 0x00A965A8; if the loaded value is zero return 0; else String_VFormat(buffer, format, &first_vararg) into a 0x400-byte frame; if 0x00A43E70 is non-null return 0x00A43E70(buffer, 0x00A43E68); otherwise call Debug_Error(buffer) at 0x004AF7B0 and execute jmp $ at 0x004B7E74. Only the disabled-state and callback paths return.

candidate_function.summary: std::int32_t Qvm_ReportError(const char* format, ...): volatile error-state storage preserves the retail flag load/store and both branches; the same 0x400-byte uninitialized frame; the same String_VFormat argument order; the callback pointer is loaded once and called as in retail; the fallback calls Debug_Error(buffer) and then a [[noreturn]] helper that emits `1: jmp 1b`.

compiled_object.observed: objdump -dr: load .data flag, store 1 to .bss flag, test/return 0 at 0x153, String_VFormat call at 0x17b, single .bss callback load and call eax at 0x19a, ret at 0x1a2, Debug_Error call at 0x1a6, jmp self (eb fe) at 0x1ab. No Error_Show call and no returning fallback.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Binary Ninja, Radare2 and angr all recover the exact entry 0x004B7E10; the candidate defines Qvm_ReportError at that retail address.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: cdecl int32_t(const char* format, ...) is preserved. String_VFormat receives (buffer, format, va_list) in the retail order; the callback receives (buffer, g_a43e68); Debug_Error receives the buffer as its only stack argument.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: The 0x400-byte frame, the flag values (1 store, 0 disabled return) and the buffer size are the literals retail uses.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The buffer is a 0x400-byte stack frame as in retail (uninitialized; no memset). The four retail globals are kept as volatile port-owned storage so the compiled object loads/stores them instead of folding them; retail writes 0x00A96598 at 0x004B8970 and clears 0x00A43E70/0x00A43E68 at 0x004B8B00.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Exactly two retail callees: String_VFormat (0x004A5702) and Debug_Error (0x004AF7B0), plus the indirect 0x00A43E70 callback. The flag store 0x00A965A8 = 1 is emitted. There is no Error_Show call and no extra memset.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Disabled state returns 0; the callback result is returned; the Debug_Error fallback never returns, matching the retail jmp $ at 0x004B7E74. Every path that returns in retail returns here.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The function formats text and copies a pointer; it performs no floating-point arithmetic.

checks.name: flag_store
checks.detail: The store of 1 at 0x00A965A8 is present in the object (.bss relocation at symbol+0x7).

checks.name: disabled_gate
checks.detail: The early return when 0x00A96598 == 0 returns 0 on the same condition.

checks.name: formatting
checks.detail: String_VFormat(buffer, format, va_list) writes the message into the 0x400-byte frame; the return value is ignored as in retail.

checks.name: callback_branch
checks.detail: The callback pointer is loaded once (as retail loads EAX at 0x004B7E43), g_a43e70(buffer, g_a43e68) is called at symbol+0x5a and its EAX is returned, matching 0x004B7E4F-0x004B7E5D.

checks.name: fallback_error_path
checks.detail: The fallback calls Debug_Error(buffer) from 0x004B7E67-0x004B7E71. The previous Error_Show("%s", buffer) call is gone; the buffer is passed as the format argument, so % sequences in the message are interpreted as retail interprets them.

checks.name: halt_path
checks.detail: The compiled fallback ends with eb fe (jmp self) at symbol+0x6b, reproducing 0x004B7E74.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports int32_t(char* arg1) and radare2 recovers cdecl with a 0x400-byte frame; the first stack argument at [esp+4] is the printf-style format and the remaining stack words are substitutions that String_VFormat consumes through the va_list. The candidate keeps cdecl, the int32_t return and the variadic argument layout. The implementation spells the format as const char*; that constness is a C++ spelling of the same ABI.

behavioural.note: No runner executes this address as its subject; no paired retail/candidate runtime capture exists, so the absence is recorded rather than binding another native's artifact.

limitations: The retail display/exit callbacks (0x004988D0/0x00498930) are unported, so the candidate Debug_Error returns 0 on the no-callback path; the fallback self-loop then reproduces the raw retail halt.

The retail writer of 0x00A96598 (0x004B8970) and the 0x004B8B00 reset that clears 0x00A43E70/0x00A43E68 are not ported; the branches are compiled but no candidate code currently changes those globals.
No paired retail/candidate game-process runtime capture exists for this address; RUNTIME_TESTED/VERIFIED is not claimed.

The CFG agreement cited here is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image; angr CFGFast is an independent approximate recovery (9 blocks/10 edges because it splits at calls), not a candidate-vs-retail isomorphism score.
cfg_similarity 1.0 is the retail BN-vs-R2 graph score (0.35*node_jaccard + 0.65*edge_jaccard); it is not candidate equivalence.
This translation unit carries seven other native records whose stored implementation sha256 is now stale; only 0x004B7E10 is rebound here.
